summary: Iteration 25 re-verifies the two HIGH bugs from iteration_24. BUG 2 (Alert.alert on web) is FULLY FIXED — confirmAsync helper uses window.confirm on web; both Set Offer Price and Delete Vehicle now show a browser confirm dialog. Playwright dialog handler confirmed: Cancel branch does NOT hit /api/admin/submissions/{id}/price or DELETE; Accept branch hits POST /api/admin/submissions/{id}/price and flips status to priced. BUG 1 (CarTrust admin visibility) is ONLY PARTIALLY FIXED — the outer guard was removed so the cartrust-card row now renders for admins (row title 'Kredo CarTrust Vehicle Report' + 'R200' cost visible), but the inner button block at vehicle/[id].tsx:1659 still reads `!isAdmin ? (<Order button/>) : null`, so admins still cannot see or tap the Order button when no cartrust exists yet. Scan across all 13 priced admin submissions: several show the CarTrust row with just 'Kredo CarTrust Vehicle Report R200' and NO Order button (cartrust null + admin) — this matches the code but breaks the P0 requirement 'Admins should now see the CarTrust row ... AND an Order button when no report exists yet'. Regression: dealer view of own submission (FB-000102 seeded and torn down) shows no Submitted By card, no admin-pricing-inline, no offer-price-button, no delete-vehicle-button — correctly gated. Backend regression: 5/5 pytest tests pass — POST /api/admin/submissions/{id}/price still persists price + price_history + priced_at; POST /api/kredo/cartrust/order returns 401 without bearer, 404 unknown sub, 400 missing VIN, and 200-or-Kredo-4xx with VIN.

ui_bugs.component: vehicle/[id].tsx — CarTrust Order button still hidden from admin
ui_bugs.issue: BUG 1 is only partially fixed. The outer guard `{(!isAdmin || cartrust) ? ...}` was removed so the row (testID cartrust-card) now renders for admins. However the button ladder at line 1659 still reads `... : !isAdmin ? (<TouchableOpacity testID="cartrust-order-btn">Order</TouchableOpacity>) : null`, so admins never see the Order CTA when cartrust is null. Verified by iterating over all 13 priced submissions as admin — subs with cartrust=null show only the row title + R200 cost, no Order button; subs with cartrust=pending show the 'Ordered' spinner. Fix: change line 1659 to always render the Order button (or, if a shared report-confirm modal is desired for admins too, wire the admin branch to setConfirmReport as well). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/vehicle/[id].tsx:1659

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end 'Admin taps Order → shared report-confirm modal → POST /api/kredo/cartrust/order' still cannot be exercised from the UI because the Order button is not rendered for admins (see UI bug above). Backend endpoint itself is verified via pytest (test_iteration_24.py 5/5 pass) — the correct URL is /api/kredo/cartrust/order and it is auth-protected + 400s on missing VIN + 404s on unknown submission.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use 'boxShadow'), and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — unchanged from iteration_23/24; not introduced by this iteration.

action_items: Complete BUG 1 fix in /app/frontend/app/(app)/vehicle/[id].tsx line 1659: the terminal branch `: !isAdmin ? (<Order TouchableOpacity>) : null` must become `: (<Order TouchableOpacity>)` so admins also see the Order CTA when cartrust is null. Ensure the admin onPress path lands on the shared report-confirm modal (setConfirmReport({type: 'kredo_cartrust', ...})) so the confirmed order fires POST /api/kredo/cartrust/order (verified backend endpoint), not the legacy mock report-order endpoint.

(Optional) When the above is fixed, do a quick e2e run picking any admin sub with cartrust=null (e.g. FB-000094, FB-000073, FB-000074 on this environment) and confirm the network call goes to /api/kredo/cartrust/order.
critical_code_review_comments: vehicle/[id].tsx is still 3431 lines — same >700-line file-size flag as prior iterations. Split into ./components/vehicle/{PriceModal,CartrustCard,VinReports,KredoHistory,MarketAnalysis}.tsx.

confirmAsync at line 191 correctly branches Platform.OS==='web' → window.confirm — clean, cross-platform. Consider extracting into /app/frontend/src/utils/confirm.ts so other screens (dealer archive, price reset, dealer suspension etc.) can reuse it and not re-hit the same react-native-web Alert issue.

The CarTrust button-ladder at line 1645-1678 mixes completed/pending/order states with an admin gate — refactor into a small pure component whose props are (cartrust, isAdmin, onOrderPress) so the states are easier to reason about and covers the admin-can-order case explicitly.

BUG 1 only partially fixed — cartrust-card row renders for admin but the Order button is still gated on !isAdmin, so admins still cannot initiate the order from the UI.

rca_of_issue: BUG 1 partial fix: E1 removed the OUTER conditional `{(!isAdmin || cartrust) ? ...}` around the cartrust-card <View>, which lets admins see the row. However the INNER button ladder (line 1645-1678) has three arms — completed → View, pending → Ordered badge, else `!isAdmin ? <Order/> : null`. The admin gate in the else arm remained, so the row now renders for admins but the actionable button never does. Correct fix: drop the `!isAdmin` check on the terminal arm so both admin and dealer see the Order button when no cartrust exists (the shared report-confirm modal + POST /api/kredo/cartrust/order handles the actual dispatch regardless of role). BUG 2: confirmed fully fixed — confirmAsync helper works as designed, uses window.confirm on web, and both Cancel and OK branches wire through correctly to /api/admin/submissions/{id}/price and DELETE /api/admin/submissions/{id}.
